tasks.short: Inspect the site against building codes.

steps.what: List the building and safety code items for this type.
Inspect the project against those building codes.
Review compliance where the code list is silent.

tasks.design: A code list for the building type is shown from {DOCS} before the visit. The construction manager inspects the project on site and reviews compliance the list does not cover, including other safety regulations. The list does not pass the work. An item that cannot be seen from the ground is not marked done.
tasks.previous_blocker: The code pages were in a folder in the site office, so the walk depended on what the manager remembered to check.
tasks.enabler_now: A written list can be opened before the visit. Seeing the work still requires the visit.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden work, verbal site changes, and national rules that are not in the list.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can see a fix that looks right on a photo and is wrong in the room.
tasks.altitude: The walk starts from a list. The inspection and the finding stay with the manager. Nothing about code compliance is decided from the desk.

reach.task: Check a control against a written obligation and record what was seen.
reach.learn: The obligation can be listed. This manager still has to see the building.

evidence.claim: A register can list code items for a building type. It cannot see the site.
Passing or failing building work is the manager's finding. The job digest's rule registers are for documents, not for a site walk. No staff score is kept of who found the defect.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Building type and code-item id, produced by the project's code list. An item with no id is not on the list the screen shows. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the code list already stored for the project before a new register.
unknowns: Which national code edition this project uses.
Who else may sign an inspection note.
research_questions: Is the code list current for this project?
What share of checks need access equipment?

already_counted.description: The manager still inspects the site.
The manager still writes the finding the list does not cover.

incremental.description: The manager adds a code item when the project type changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The visit is the task. Saving is only the list prepared beforehand, and it disappears when the code edition on file is the wrong one and the manager rebuilds it.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and implement the quality program.

steps.what: Open the check library for this project type.
Develop the quality control program for this site.
Implement the program by signing the version in use.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} library opens the checks used on a similar project type. The construction manager develops the quality control program for this site and signs the version that will be used. The library does not implement the program. A check that does not match this structure is left out until the manager writes it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each site copied the last program and hoped the checks still fitted.
tasks.enabler_now: A library can show the last signed checks. Choosing which apply is still the manager.
tasks.still_hard: A novel structure, a client specification that contradicts the usual check, and crews who will not follow a paper they did not hear explained.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which check this crew will actually perform, and which one would only exist on paper.
tasks.altitude: The program starts from a library instead of a blank page. The manager still writes it and still signs the version the site must use.

reach.task: Issue a control set and name the person who will run it.
reach.learn: A library is not the program. This manager still signs what the site will use.

evidence.claim: A document library can store signed checks with a version. It cannot decide which checks this site needs.
Putting a program into force is the manager's decision. The job digest says policy texts need an owner to decide. No monitoring score of the crew is added.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Project type and check id, produced by the signed library. The program version is produced by the manager, not by copying the library unchanged. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the existing quality-check documents before a new library.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: Who on site is allowed to mark a check done.
Whether the client imposes its own program.
research_questions: How often is the last project's program reused unchanged?

already_counted.description: The manager still develops the program.
The manager still signs the version in use.

incremental.description: The manager retires a check when the client specification changes.

approvals.approved_version: program version and the check list shown to the manager

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Writing and signing the program stay with the manager. Saving is opening the last checks, and it shrinks when this structure matches none of them.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Schedule construction activities to the deadline.

steps.what: Schedule construction project activities to the deadline.
Coordinate activities the dates cannot settle.
Approve the schedule before it is issued.

tasks.design: Activities with dependencies and durations are scheduled in {PROJECT} against the deadline. The construction manager coordinates the activities the dates cannot settle, such as shared access and drying time that was never entered, and approves the schedule before it is issued. A missing duration stops that activity. The schedule does not move a crew.
tasks.previous_blocker: The programme lived in one person's file and was redrawn after every argument on site.
tasks.enabler_now: Dependencies and durations can be calculated. Shared access and a promise to a neighbour cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Weather, late design, and a subcontractor who will not accept the date.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which date is real on this site and which one only satisfies the software.

ambition.what: Reissue the schedule for a small package in the same week it slips, not only at the monthly client meeting.

tasks.altitude: Arithmetic of dates leaves the evening. The manager still coordinates the awkward sequence and still issues the schedule.

reach.role: Property, Real Estate, and Community Association Managers
reach.task: Plan maintenance work against a date the building can actually take.
reach.learn: A date calculation is not the coordination. This manager still issues the programme.

evidence.claim: A project plan can order activities that have durations and dependencies. It cannot invent a duration.
The job digest says scheduling constraints can be configured, and that named rosters need works-council consent. This schedule is activities and dates, not a roster of named workers.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Activity id, duration, and predecessor ids, produced by the project plan. An activity with no duration is left unscheduled. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the existing project plan before a second scheduling tool.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: Who may change a date after issue.
Which constraints are contractual rather than physical.
research_questions: What share of activities have a duration and a predecessor?
How often is the issued schedule revised in a month?

already_counted.description: The manager still coordinates the sequence the dates cannot settle.
The manager still approves the issued schedule.

incremental.description: The manager adds a dependency when the method changes.

approvals.approved_version: schedule version and the activity dates shown to the manager

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If durations are missing, the manager still builds the programme by hand and the saving stays near the low end. Complete dependencies keep the high end, which stays under half the task because coordination remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare budget estimates from the cost codes.
Draft the progress report from those figures.

loop.input: the estimate and the report template
loop.check: every sentence cites a cost-code figure in the estimate
loop.stop: stop when a sentence has no figure
loop.why_not_simpler: commentary is prose, but it is not allowed to add a number

steps.what: Check every sentence against the cost figures.

tasks.design: Budget estimates and the cost tracking table come from {ERP} cost codes and commitments. A progress report is drafted only from those figures. The construction manager checks every sentence against the figures, and only then is the report submitted. A sentence with no figure is dropped. The draft does not explain a variance the table does not contain.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager rekeyed costs into a sheet and wrote the commentary from memory of the month.
tasks.enabler_now: Posted costs can fill an estimate. A sentence still has to be checked against those costs.
tasks.still_hard: Costs in the wrong code, and a client who wants a story the figures do not support.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which variance is timing and which one is a real overrun on this package.

ambition.what: Send a cost picture for a small package in the same week, not only inside the monthly report.

tasks.altitude: Rekeying leaves the week. The manager still checks the commentary and still owns what is submitted to the client.

reach.task: Comment on a cost only when the figure is in the pack.
reach.learn: A drafted sentence that cites nothing has to be cut. This manager still signs the report.

evidence.claim: Posted cost codes can produce an estimate and a tracking table. Commentary is only safe when each sentence cites one of those figures.

The job digest records a public report that cited sources it did not hold, and the firm repaid part of the fee. This draft may use only the cost pack. Submitting the report is the manager's act. No vendor percentage is used as the saving.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Cost code, budget, commitment, and actual, produced by the finance system. The commentary may not introduce a number that is not in that pack. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the existing project cost report before a new one.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: How late the cost codes are posted.
research_questions: What share of site costs hit the right code in the same week?
Who may submit the report besides this manager?

already_counted.description: The manager still checks the report against the figures.

incremental.description: The manager maps a new cost code when a package is added.

approvals.approved_version: estimate id and the report text shown against the figures
checked report id about to be submitted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If costs are in the wrong code, the manager rebuilds the table and the saving stays near the low end. Clean codes keep the high end, and the check of the commentary remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still walks the site and still writes the quality program. A deadline schedule and a cost report can be prepared before the meeting.
reach: Compliance managers keep an obligation register, and this job learns a code list is not the inspection.
Architectural and engineering managers read a design against a brief, and this job learns a cost comment must cite a figure.
skills_to_grow: Read a progress sentence back to a cost code before the report is sent.
Tell a scheduled date from a sequence the site still has to coordinate.
role.ambitious_version: A small package gets a cost picture in the same week, and the site inspection still waits for the manager.
